bundle.shortDescription: Copy and move files between volumes, and prove what landed.
bundle.longDescription: CrossPort copies and moves files and folders between volumes. Every transfer is reviewed before it is queued, verified after it is written, kept in a durable history, and left for the user to restart or discard if it is interrupted. It works offline, with no account, no telemetry, and no background synchronization.
